findings.issue: 重そう here is the appearance-そう on the stem of 重い (heavy), so it reads おもそう, not じゅうそう (on-reading). The record's own expl_en/expl_pt explicitly give the root as 重(おも). Kana teaches a wrong reading.
Follows the wrong kana reading: 重そう must be omosou (stem of 重い + appearance そう), not juusou.
Token reading for 重そう is じゅうそう; correct is おもそう (い-adjective stem 重(おも) + そう of appearance, as the token's own note states).
便 in the medical sense 'stool' reads べん, not びん (びん = flight/mail). The record's own expl_en/expl_pt state 'Here 便 is read べん, não びん', contradicting the kana.
findings.current: やわらかいびんがでます。
findings.suggested: やわらかいべんがでます。

findings.issue: Follows the wrong kana: 便 (stool) is ben, not bin.
Token reading for 便 is びん, but in this context (fezes) it is べん — the token's own gloss even annotates '(べん)'.

〜なくてはならない expresses obligation ('must/have to'), but the en renders it as desire ('want to'), contradicting lit_en ('I have to eat...') and pt ('Preciso comer...'). Misleads learners about the target grammar's meaning.
findings.current: You want to eat before you go.
findings.suggested: I have to eat before going out.

findings.issue: lit_en is a natural translation, not a structural mirror, and is not parallel to lit_pt ('Antes de sair, se não comer, não dá'), which correctly decomposes なくてはならない as 'if not eat, it won't do'.
findings.current: I have to eat before going out.
findings.suggested: Before going out, if (I) don't eat, it won't do.

findings.issue: ほかの人に is mirrored with a spurious duplicated noun ('de outras pessoas, às pessoas'), rendering one 人 twice and garbling the structural gloss.
findings.current: Durante a aula (quanto a), de outras pessoas, às pessoas dirigir a palavra, quanto a (isso), não pode.
findings.suggested: Durante a aula (quanto a), a outras pessoas dirigir a palavra, quanto a (isso), não pode.

findings.issue: 'Come make' inverts the 〜てくる structure (do the action, then come back); it reads as 'come here and make'. lit_pt mirrors it correctly as 'tirar-vir'.
findings.current: Come make a reduced copy (object), you see.

findings.issue: The adverb いつしか ('before one knew it') is entirely omitted from the natural English, though pt renders it ('sem que se percebesse') and it is glossed in the tokens.
findings.suggested: Before we knew it, autumn had turned into winter.

findings.issue: 以上は clauses express a premise/reason ('já que'), never concession; labeling the clause 'condicional/concessiva' contradicts the 以上 token gloss and both expl fields ('já que / uma vez que').
findings.suggested: verbo principal (oração de premissa/causal com 以上は, 'já que')

findings.issue: 消す is glossed 'to turn off' in the explanation, but in 火を消す the contextual sense is 'to put out/extinguish' (as the token gloss and expl_pt 'apagar' correctly have).
findings.current: Main verb 消し (of 消す, 'to turn off') takes なさい
findings.suggested: Main verb 消し (of 消す, 'to put out') takes なさい
